::: {.callout-note}
## Executive Summary
- **Total Net Revenue:** Realized aggregate gross sales reflect healthy volume across core markets.
- **Primary Margin Driver:** Electronics & Furniture represent 60% of volume but face structural compression from discounts exceeding 15%.
- **Action Item:** Enforce a hard approval gate for category discounts $>10\%$ in APAC and LATAM to reclaim estimated 3.4% blended margin.
:::

```{python}
import duckdb
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import pandas as pd

# In-memory analytical connection directly against parquet
con = duckdb.connect()

summary_query = """
SELECT 
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(cogs) AS total_cogs,
    SUM(revenue - cogs) AS gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue - cogs) / SUM(revenue) * 100, 2) AS blended_margin_pct
FROM 'data/sales_sample.parquet'
"""
kpi = con.execute(summary_query).df().iloc[0]
```

## Portfolio Financial Performance

```{python}
fig_kpi = go.Figure()
fig_kpi.add_trace(go.Indicator(
    mode="number",
    value=kpi['total_revenue'],
    number={'prefix': "$", 'valueformat': ",.0f"},
    title={'text': "Total Revenue"},
    domain={'row': 0, 'column': 0}
))
fig_kpi.add_trace(go.Indicator(
    mode="number",
    value=kpi['gross_profit'],
    number={'prefix': "$", 'valueformat': ",.0f"},
    title={'text': "Gross Profit"},
    domain={'row': 0, 'column': 1}
))
fig_kpi.add_trace(go.Indicator(
    mode="number",
    value=kpi['blended_margin_pct'],
    number={'suffix': "%"},
    title={'text': "Blended Gross Margin"},
    domain={'row': 0, 'column': 2}
))
fig_kpi.update_layout(grid={'rows': 1, 'columns': 3, 'pattern': 'independent'}, height=220)
fig_kpi.show()
```

## Margin by Product Category & Region

```{python}
cat_query = """
SELECT 
    category,
    region,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue - cogs) / SUM(revenue) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM 'data/sales_sample.parquet'
GROUP BY category, region
ORDER BY revenue DESC
"""
df_cat = con.execute(cat_query).df()

fig_bar = px.bar(
    df_cat,
    x="category",
    y="revenue",
    color="margin_pct",
    barmode="group",
    facet_col="region",
    labels={"margin_pct": "Margin %", "revenue": "Revenue ($)"},
    color_continuous_scale="Viridis",
    title="Regional Revenue Distribution by Realized Margin %"
)
fig_bar.show()
```

## Discount Leakage Analysis

```{python}
leakage_query = """
SELECT 
    discount_pct,
    category,
    ROUND(AVG((revenue - cogs) / revenue * 100), 2) AS avg_margin_pct
FROM 'data/sales_sample.parquet'
GROUP BY discount_pct, category
ORDER BY discount_pct ASC
"""
df_leakage = con.execute(leakage_query).df()

fig_scatter = px.line(
    df_leakage,
    x="discount_pct",
    y="avg_margin_pct",
    color="category",
    markers=True,
    title="Gross Margin Erosion across Discount Bands",
    labels={"discount_pct": "Discount Rate", "avg_margin_pct": "Realized Margin %"}
)
fig_scatter.show()
```
